h1: Visiting family in India: which visa do you need?
title: Visiting Family in India? Which Visa You Need from the UK
description: Visiting family in India from the UK? Most people use the India e-Tourist visa, and OCI holders don’t need one. We check which applies to you.
intro: India doesn’t have a separate family visit visa. If you are visiting relatives or friends, the e-Tourist visa is usually the right one, and if you hold an OCI card you don’t need a visa at all. If you are visiting family in India, we’ll make sure you apply for the right visa.
eligibility: You are visiting relatives or friends in India for a short stay
You hold a passport from a country eligible for India’s eVisa
You won’t work or study during your visit
documents: Recent passport-style photo with a white background
Address of the relatives you’ll stay with (optional)

sections.heading: The e-Tourist visa covers family visits
sections.text: Visiting friends and relatives is one of the purposes allowed on India's e-Tourist visa. You choose between a 30-day visa with two entries, or 1-year and 5-year visas with multiple entries. If you visit family regularly, a longer visa saves you applying every time.

sections.heading: OCI card holders
sections.text: If you are a former Indian citizen or of Indian origin and hold an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, you can visit India for as long as you like without a visa. If you have recently become British, you need to surrender your Indian passport and get a surrender certificate before applying for OCI. We help with both.

sections.heading: People of Pakistani origin
sections.text: If you were born in Pakistan, hold Pakistani nationality, or your parents or grandparents did, you can't use the eVisa. You need to apply for a regular visa through the Indian visa application centre. We prepare these applications too.

sections.heading: Visiting family? We can help
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Indian eVisas for clients across the UK, entirely online. We complete your application, check every detail against your passport and keep you updated until your eVisa arrives.

faqs.q: Is there a family visit visa for India?
faqs.a: No separate one. Visiting relatives is covered by the e-Tourist visa, and OCI card holders don’t need a visa.

faqs.q: Which e-Tourist visa should I choose for family visits?
faqs.a: If you visit once, the 30-day visa is usually enough. If you visit family every year, the 1-year or 5-year visa is better value.

faqs.q: Can I stay with relatives when visiting family in India on an e-Tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Staying with relatives is fine on an e-Tourist visa. You can give their address in the application.
